name: The Drawn Hour
descriptionSeed: The Drawn Hour — an outpost where pattern-readers and hour-keepers compare notes on what repeats. A figurist sees the shape of a thing; an hourkeeper sees how often. Between them they can usually say when it will happen again.
encounterFlavor: two crews who share a yard, a road, and a long-running disagreement

substrateSource.reason: An Hourkeeper levy-post: time taken off things and never returned has to be taken SOMEWHERE, and it has been taken here for decades.
substrateSource.radiusNote: `radius` is in legacy map units; `radiusWorld` is RADII on the sphere and is the one mechanics should use. Chosen by sweep against the authored worldPos: at this scale all 26 sources resolve on the correct side of their region baseline and calibration drift stays ~0.05. Larger radii blanket a whole region (a source at ~55% strength everywhere inside it) and renormalization cancels the field flat — the failure CCode measured and reverted.

axisVectorNote: Derived from authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder. ⚠️ Exactly two non-zero components — the signature of a two-domain balance.
worldPosNote: ⚠️ THE MIDPOINT BETWEEN cloudform AND the_slow_hour.
